verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents auto-replies, missed-call text-back, after-hours replies, or scheduled texts. The closest items fall outside this story: the Sona AI agent answering calls is an adjacent feature, MCP text sending is a one-off action rather than a recurring or scheduled send, and message webhooks are developer building blocks. None of these count as the product's own auto-reply or scheduling capability.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can send auto-replies and scheduled texts, like missed-call text-back and after-hours replies
